# Afsnit 337: Novo Nordisk og Zealand Pharmas kursfald

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-09-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish hosts Hansen and Larsen cover Trump's pressure on the Fed for lower rates, the risk of a large dollar weakening, and an expected ECB hike to 2.5% driven by rising energy prices and inflation. They preview Oracle's earnings as a test of AI demand and of whether OpenAI can pay for its huge order backlog, and discuss the upcoming Anthropic and OpenAI IPOs. Most of the episode is about how volatile, range-bound trading in Novo Nordisk and Zealand Pharma tests patient buy-and-hold investors, with Novo's capital markets day in London on 21 September as the next catalyst.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Earnings Thursday are a read on AI demand. Watch whether OpenAI can pay for its backlog, the debt load, and 2027 guidance. The stock has fallen from about 340 to 115.

#### Reasoning

Host says to keep an eye on Oracle's report in relation to OpenAI and AI, and on its full-year 2027 guidance. The large backlog is debt-financed, the credit rating is close to junk, and a big share of the backlog depends on OpenAI. Historically the stock rose on average 3.1% after earnings, and the moves are large. The outcome matters for the whole AI trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak 2027 guidance
- doubts about OpenAI's ability to pay for the backlog
- credit downgrade to junk

> *"Så håll öje med Oracle i relation till OpenAI och AI och håll öje med deras guidance för hela 2027."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Trades in a range of about 225–330 driven by short-term money. Capital markets day on 21 Sep in London is the catalyst. Investors want news on pill production capacity.

#### Reasoning

Hosts describe Novo as range-bound with many short-term traders. Buy-and-hold returns have been disappointing, but the swings create trading opportunities. Many in their network bought at 225–250. Expectations for the CMD are high but nothing groundbreaking is priced in; the focus is pill production capacity. They make no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- disappointing capital markets day
- further guidance cut
- falls below the 225 range bottom

> *"Det jag vet med garanti är att investorerna håller extremt mycket öje med Novo Nordisk när det drejer sig om cirka två uger."*

---

### 🟡 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest Helge has held it long term in his pension at a low cost basis and swing-trades it in free funds. It is highly volatile and moves in a trading range.

#### Reasoning

Helge (guest opinion) keeps a long-term holding in his pension and says that in free funds the stock should be traded because of algorithm and short-interest driven swings of about 50%. Buy-and-hold has given disappointing returns, and he warns that a trader who has sold out could miss a takeover bid.

#### Sell Triggers

- company performs very poorly in the market
- long-term obesity trend breaks

> *"i frimidlet har jag helt klart ment att det är en aktie som bör tradas, i alla fall om man har den"*
